relations.subject: Jacques Bacot
relations.role: director of studies (directeur d'études) of Tibetan
relations.evidence: Jacques Bacot was named director of studies (directeur d'études) of Tibetan at l'École pratique des hautes études in 1936.

relations.subject: Jacques Bacot
relations.evidence: He acquired aid from Gendün Chöphel in studying Dunhuang manuscripts.

relations.subject: Jacques Bacot
relations.evidence: After his return to France in 1908, he devoted himself to the study of Tibetan with Sylvain Lévi.

relations.subject: Jacques Bacot
relations.evidence: He became a member of l'Académie des inscriptions et belles-lettres in 1947

relations.subject: Jacques Bacot
relations.evidence: entered the Société Asiatique in 1908. He became president after the death of Paul Pelliot, in 1945, and remained so until 1954.
